data_origin: Pinned Chinese community translation snapshots from Tomato ROS; not official Autoware translations.
corpus_scope: Chinese-only public demo corpus from Tomato ROS community translation snapshots: current snapshot at commit eb089f637534f1e84b8d0c950be1ab302ee22c50 (2026-07, 260 pages) and historical snapshot at commit 5f2ee521d5f26cfe832d6d6abf6d1885909706cd (2026-01, 259 comparable pages). These are repository snapshot dates, not Autoware product release versions. English source documents and English-only product snapshots are excluded.
